steps.path: Any popup with a main action and Cancel
steps.hint: Each pane is a real popup. Try a dark theme and Meadow Mist too.
steps.headline: A popup with a main action and Cancel: which arrangement?
steps.notice: You said: the dark button always on the right, the light one directly to its left; a single button often full width; sometimes stacked, sometimes side by side.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Plain-text Cancel left; the dark button stretched across the rest.

variants.label: Pair on the right
variants.summary: Outlined Cancel directly left of the dark button, both at the right edge.

variants.label: Equal halves
variants.summary: Cancel and the dark button share the width, dark on the right.

variants.label: Stacked
variants.summary: Dark button full width on top, Cancel full width under it.

steps.path: The same popup at phone width
steps.headline: The same popup on a phone: which arrangement?
steps.notice: Phone and narrow windows. Pick the same as above if nothing should change on a phone.

variants.label: Pair on the right
variants.summary: Kept side by side at the right edge.

variants.label: Equal halves
variants.summary: Side by side, each half the width.

variants.label: Stacked
variants.summary: Dark button on top, Cancel under it, both full width.

steps.path: Any popup with one main action (e.g. Submit a ticket)
steps.headline: A popup with a single button: full width, right, or centered?
steps.notice: You said: the dark button always on the right, the light one directly to its left; a single button often full width; sometimes stacked, sometimes side by side.

variants.label: On the right
variants.summary: The button hugs its label at the right edge.

variants.label: Centered
variants.summary: The button hugs its label in the middle.

steps.path: A confirmation that removes or deletes something
steps.headline: In a "remove this?" confirmation, which side does the red button go?
steps.notice: Today the app does this both ways. The red button is the main action here.

variants.label: Red on the right
variants.summary: Cancel, then the red button last — where the dark button always goes.

variants.label: Red on the left
variants.summary: The red button first, Cancel after it.

steps.path: A question the assistant asks you in the chat
steps.headline: Should chat questions follow the popup rule too?
steps.notice: Today chat cards put the dark button first, on the left — the opposite of popups.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Dark Submit first on the left, a quiet Dismiss after it.

variants.label: Same as popups
variants.summary: Outlined Dismiss directly left of a dark Submit, at the right edge.

steps.path: The permission row under a command the assistant wants to run
steps.headline: Should the permission row be mirrored so Yes ends on the right?
steps.notice: These are the buttons you press most. The arrow keys follow the same order, and the highlighted button still starts on Yes either way.
steps.risk: Mirroring changes where your hand goes for the most-used buttons in the app; it takes a few days to get used to.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Yes · Always Allow · No, from the left.

variants.label: Mirrored
variants.summary: No · Always Allow · Yes, at the right edge.
